formalProvenance.sourceWindowScope: Root accepted these exact model/test/contract pins before authorizing the first run; this tool independently hashed them later. This is a wider review-to-later-recheck window, NOT a separately recorded immediate test-end hash snapshot. Original runner report contains only one source-hash set.

independentReview.scope: Independent offline arithmetic review of the existing first six ordinary model rounds; no model or pilot execution.
method: Reconstruct accepted command receipts from recorded held/released keys; check absolute targets, fixed delay, FIFO application and each checkpoint pending queue.

Partition at old-tick weather boundaries, application ticks and water phases. T/H use discrete geometric decay; soil uses the cumulative old-temperature positive part, split at T=24 and soil increment sign/clamp changes.

Evaluate the closed form at integer endpoints, then independently count each crop comfort conjunction, danger union, maturity cap, continued mature damage, unfinished-crop dry stall and first terminal tick.
Compare every retained/command/application/initial/final full state and every compact climate/progress checkpoint; no observed climate is used to restart the oracle.
limitations: Double-precision geometric formulas rearrange the contract arithmetic and are not bit-identical to repeated IEEE-754 Euler updates.
Only six existing ordinary rounds are evidence. Oracle hand fixtures are separate arithmetic checks, not game runs or production boundary tests.
Input evidence has one key at a time, direction holds below 20 ticks, and no pause/retry/cancel/subtick events; those behaviors are outside this review.
The six rounds do not establish simultaneous terminal precedence or post-terminal freeze behavior. The terminal rule is independently evaluated along the observed trajectories.
T/H equilibrium bounds under authored controls stay inside their clamps; soil clamp handling is explicit but ordinary coverage is reported rather than presumed.
Recorded keyboard mapping is evidence-specific; this review makes no browser or physical-device claim.

descriptions: One tick at T=24 with drip1 confirms old-temperature evaporation.
0.025 litre with drip2 over three ticks separates full, partial and dry flow.

correction.reason: Correct partial-flow coverage classification relative to the applied drip level. A final drip2 tick using 1/120 litre was incorrectly counted as full flow. Climate arithmetic, integer counters and terminal checks are unchanged; the first review is preserved.

candidateNormalPlay.applicationScope: Trace holds real public samples. A missing lastAppliedCommands event is not fabricated; accepted commands, current applied levels and pending counters remain available.

gameRules.scope: Separate crop maturity and damage, shared climate, finite water and delayed absolute actuator queues. Climate integration is independently reviewed from the sole six-round corpus; recording uses only actual sampled facts.

modelTests.scope: 14 directed model rule/input tests, including explicitly labeled synthetic mutated fixtures. No ordinary-play, browser, recording, or physical-TV result is claimed. Source identity compares the root-approved pre-run pins with a delayed root recheck; no immediate test-end source snapshot was recorded. Original spec output and metadata parser correction are preserved; no rerun.

checks.name: P freezes gameplay state and tick, P resumes
R restarts with clean simulation state
resizing keeps canvas and complete sidebar text visible
no page, console or resource errors
three menus show distinct initial climates and delays with empty queues and no accumulated growth
held START starts once and phone direction changes selection without enqueuing a command
held phone A and native Enter each enqueue one delayed absolute command and cannot act immediately
B decreases the requested level without cancelling FIFO history; pause freezes queued deadlines and climate
connected cancellation suppresses stale input but deliberately queued actuation and climate continue
disconnect pauses a pending actuator and clears held selection; intentional resume preserves its original due tick
ordinary unmanaged drip naturally spends the reservoir and reaches the unfinished-crop dry-stall limit
R restores initial climate, water, growth, damage and empty actuator queues before actual ticks resume
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryDelayedControl.scope: Real key edges, permanent counters and saved command/application receipts only. Missing issue/application observations remain explicit; no control tick, climate trajectory or exact screenshot state is fabricated.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
